verdict.rationale: Evidence shows skills can be installed into a project directory (probe-rt-1 shows a real install writing to ./.claude/skills/, which would be committed with the repo) and separately that some harnesses recognize a user-global path ~/.agents/skills/ (superpowers-docs-31), implying both scopes exist. But there's no explicit documentation framing this as a deliberate developer choice between project-local vs user-global install, and install mechanics are described as harness-specific plugin installs (superpowers-gh-5, superpowers-docs-48) rather than a scope toggle. Missing for 10: explicit first-party instructions or flag for choosing project-local vs global scope, and confirmation that project-local installs are meant to be committed to the repo.
